finding.statement: Canonical main had already made Forge execution replay identity delta_id-stable, but training-bearing CLAY_DISTILLERY_FORGE_EXECUTION_PACKET/v2 still contained both delta_id and evaluated_at. Consequently two fresh rebuilds of the same measured execution could retain one replay/measured-evidence identity while producing different packet_text bytes and token counts.
finding.counterhypothesis: Keeping evaluated_at and delta_id in packet_text is harmless because replay identity already suppresses duplicate admission in one persistent database.
finding.counterhypothesis_disposition: REJECTED_AT_REBUILD_CONTRACT_LEVEL: fresh databases do not share prior duplicate state; training-bearing bytes must be a function of measured execution evidence rather than first-observed envelope metadata.

behavior: exclude evaluated_at and delta_id from measured packet bytes
retain evaluated_at and delta_id as observation-only metadata
derive measured-evidence digest from the exact same replay-stable measured packet preimage
require equivalent fresh rebuilds to emit identical packet/replay/measured identities and token counts
require delta_id-only semantic replay after database reopen to be duplicate with zero token delta
retain conservative legacy replay collision fail-closed behavior
